name: Charles IV of Spain
contribution: King of Spain and ruler of the Spanish Empire from 1788 to 1808.
legacy: The reign of this person turned out to be a major negative turning point in Spanish history.

checks.lead: Charles IV (Spanish: Carlos Antonio Pascual Francisco Javier Juan Nepomuceno José Januario Serafín Diego de Borbón y Sajonia; 11 November 1748 – 20 January 1819) was King of Spain and ruler of the Spanish Empire from 1788 to 1808.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
